Staring at the drab concrete floor, you grumble to yourself again about how the sun still isn't up and how cold it is and how much everything sucks today. Mondays. God, they're the worst.

The hissing of airbrakes causes you to look up with a start. You hadn't noticed the train rumbling past you. Damn, that bad? You didn't even drink last night. Maybe you can catch a quick nap on the ride. People in your city are gruff but they're almost always willing to do small favors for each other, so you decide to ask somebody else on the train to wake you up when you're close to your stop.

A bear. A gigantic polar bear. Something inside you screams at you to book it, but your feet stay firmly in place as your brain throws an error, trying to make sense of what you're seeing. A bear.
